svg.text: HOW TO MAKE IT AND HOW IT FITS

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Outline: a 400 mm circle round the gear centre joined by straight

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: sides to a 100 mm circle round the crank shaft centre (196 above).

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Face: 2 mm sheet cut to the outline; 32 mm hole for the crank shaft.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Rim: 2 mm strip 50 wide, rolled and welded round the face edge,

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: so the guard is a cup 50 deep, open toward the cheek.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Spacers: three 14 OD tubes 44 long between the cheek and the cup

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: edge: 150 ahead and behind and 120 below the gear centre, and

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: M8 bolts through cup, spacer and cheek (drill the cheek 9 mm).

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Paint bright yellow so the moving gears are marked.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Fit: 11 mm clear of the gear teeth, 3.5 mm round the crank shaft.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: no finger can reach the gear mesh from outside the guard.
